# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_MEAN_REVERSION_TO_VWAP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When VIX is low (<12) indicating complacency and price extends above VWAP with overbought RSI (>70), a mean-reversion to VWAP offers a short edge. This occurs because low VIX environments often precede mean-reverting moves after extended deviations from VWAP, especially when short-term momentum (8-EMA < 21-EMA) shows weakening bias.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Require VIX (daily close) <12; compute RSI(14) >70; if price is >0.2% above VWAP and the 8-EMA <21-EMA (weak short-term bias), enter short at close of the bar where price first crosses below VWAP after meeting the above conditions. Exit shape: stop at the recent swing high (prior 3-bar high), TP1 at 1.5×ATR risk, runner trailed using chandelier trail (ATR×3). Regime hint: Only in low-VIX, low-volatility environments; avoid when VIX >18 or during news‑driven spikes.
